name: Gemini Skills
desc: Reusable instruction sets Gemini loads for specific tasks
desc_zh: 让 Gemini 按需加载的可复用指令集
solves: The same instructions get retyped in every chat; a skill saves them once and Gemini applies it on matching prompts.
solves_zh: 同样的指令每次对话都要重敲，技能保存一次后遇到匹配提问就自动套用。
best_for: Every deck must follow the house style, and you want Gemini to start from that format.
best_for_zh: 每份演示都要符合公司风格，希望 Gemini 一开始就按这个格式来。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://gemini.google/release-notes (official Gemini Apps release updates)）。 Entry dated 2026.09.30; the quote stops before footnote marker 1. Rolling out globally in chat (18+). The entry says skills will replace Gems, with automatic migration. Same vocabulary as Anthropic's Agent Skills. Second source is not independent media. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「skills」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://gemini.google/release-notes
